title: System Design Fundamentals
intro: System design questions for Rails engineers combine general distributed systems knowledge with Rails-specific implementation patterns. Caching in Rails has multiple layers — HTTP caching with ETags, fragment caching, Russian doll caching, and the Rails cache store (usually Redis). Scaling Rails means understanding Puma thread count, database connection pool sizing, read replicas with ActiveRecord::Base.connected_to, and horizontal scaling with stateless servers. Multi-tenancy is a recurring architecture question at SaaS Rails companies — row-level isolation with a tenant scope, schema-per-tenant with the Apartment gem, or database-per-tenant each with different trade-offs. This page covers each with concrete Rails examples and the capacity numbers interviewers expect.
